scope: Five original overview pages, two native-pixel detail sheets and focused eye-accessory detail actually inspected before 36 separate HIGH requests were frozen. Exact original appearance controls every variant; source135/18 is described by the actual opaque black eye-cover geometry rather than inferring a lens/patch identity. Fine lip observations use the new restrained prefix; clear facial hair remains preserved. No returned outcome or improvement claimed.
